paragraphs.text: A museum in a northern city holds no objects at all. Its collection is sound: three thousand recordings of workplaces, streets and machines, some of which no longer exist anywhere.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Recording is harder than it looks. A microphone in a workshop picks up the ventilation as loudly as the lathe, and curators often return three or four times before a recording is usable.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Visitors listen in small dark rooms, with one recording each, and the museum reports that people stay far longer than in a room of photographs of the same workplaces.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The archive is also used by people who cannot visit. Film-makers licence the recordings, and one hospital plays them to patients who grew up in the district.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: A museum in a northern city holds no objects at all.

explanation.en: A collection of sound that cannot be seen → i.
explanation.ru: Коллекция из звуков, которую нельзя увидеть → i.

items.quote: Recording is harder than it looks.

explanation.en: The difficulty of recording: the ventilation is louder than the lathe → ii.
explanation.kk: Жазудың қиындығы: желдеткіш станоктан қатты → ii.
explanation.ru: Трудности записи: вентиляция громче станка → ii.

items.quote: Visitors listen in small dark rooms

explanation.en: How visitors listen and how long they stay → iii.
explanation.kk: Келушілер қалай тыңдайды және қанша уақыт қалады → iii.
explanation.ru: Как слушают посетители и сколько остаются → iii.

explanation.en: Other uses: film-makers and a hospital → iv.
explanation.kk: Мұрағаттың басқа қолданысы: кино мен аурухана → iv.
explanation.ru: Другие применения архива: кино и больница → iv.
